title: Braille Calculator
subtitle: A visual prototype for an accessible hardware calculator
description: A frontend prototype showcasing the design of a hardware calculator with braille markings and voice assistance for visually impaired users.

overview.challenge: The prototype needed to communicate how a physical calculator could make common controls identifiable through braille while providing voice assistance for visually impaired users.
overview.solution: I built a frontend-only visual prototype in React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS. It showcases a proposed hardware calculator layout with braille-marked buttons, a display, power control, and voice-volume controls; it does not include a backend or represent a completed hardware product.

contributors.name: Joseph Bataller
contributors.imageAlt: Joseph Bataller wearing a black graduation robe
contributions: Designed a visual prototype for a hardware calculator intended for visually impaired users.
Created braille-marked number and operator controls to demonstrate the proposed physical layout.
Showcased voice assistance through dedicated power and volume controls.
Built and styled the frontend-only prototype with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS.

highlights: Prototype of a proposed hardware calculator
Voice assistance with power and volume controls

modules.title: Hardware Calculator Prototype
modules.description: A frontend visualization of a proposed physical calculator that combines familiar numeric and arithmetic controls with braille markings and voice assistance for visually impaired users.
